name: Filesystem
description: Filesystem operations within a mounted volume: read (with batch), write, edit (exact-match + patch), navigate (list/tree/stat), search (glob/grep with ripgrep + context), and manage files. Path-traversal safe, shell-injection safe, gitignore aware.

changelog.notes: Read, write, edit and patch files, browse folders, search by name or content, and manage media and hashes
